access.legal_access_basis: EEC Collegium Decision No. 88 of 2016-07-26 defines an interested party as a legal or natural person requesting and receiving information from the unified TR TS 018/2011 register through the Union information portal.
access.current_portal_observation: The portal root checked on 2026-11-04 redirects to the EAEU open-data portal; a current OTTS-specific search endpoint was not independently resolved.

limitations: Decision No. 88 describes information exchange and portal access but does not itself grant a VAG TECH PRO license to bulk copy, cache, redistribute or create a derivative database.
The EAEU open-data portal advertises OData/REST reuse for published resources, but inclusion of the OTTS register in that open-data catalog has not been established.

An OTTS establishes type/variant homologation only to the extent explicitly stated in the document; it is not an individual VIN build sheet and does not establish ECU, DTC, wiring or repair applicability.
